directorySafety.agreement: both clients refuse the same characters, so a device book is portable between them
directorySafety.whyHere: the reference client cannot escape a directory into the single command string it hands to cmd.exe, and `%`/`!` expand even inside double quotes
directorySafety.whyStill: the Android client has no shell in the path and does not need the restriction; it applies it to stay interoperable
